```{r}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  eval = TRUE

# load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(hms)
library(readr)
library(sf)
#library(tmap)
library(viridis)

```


```{r}

fatalstormdata <- read.csv("../data/FINAL_wrangled_storm.csv")

stormcount <- read.csv("../data/stormcount.csv")

```

```{r}


stormsimple <- fatalstormdata |>
  count(EVENT_TYPE, sort = TRUE)

g <- ggplot(data = stormsimple, aes(x = fct_reorder(EVENT_TYPE, n), y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", aes(color = EVENT_TYPE, fill = EVENT_TYPE)) +
  coord_flip() +
  guides(color = "none", 
         fill = "none")

g
```

```{r}

stormcount <- fatalstormdata |>
  select(YEAR, EVENT_TYPE) |>
  unite(storm, YEAR, EVENT_TYPE, sep = ",") |>
  count(storm) |>
  separate(storm, into = c("YEAR", "EVENT_TYPE"), sep = ",")

stormgif <- stormcount |>
  mutate(YEAR = as.integer(stormcount$YEAR))

g2 <- ggplot(stormgif, aes(x = EVENT_TYPE, y = n, fill = EVENT_TYPE, color = EVENT_TYPE)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
  transition_time(YEAR) +
  labs(title = "Number of fatal storms by type from 1950-2026",
       subtitle = "Year: {frame_time}",
       x = " ",
       y = "Number of events") +
  ease_aes("linear")

animate(g2)

```

```{r}

stormidk <- stormgif |>
  mutate(lesstypes = fct_collapse(EVENT_TYPE,
                                  Floods = c("Flood", "Flash Flood"),
                                  Winds = c("Thunderstorm Wind", "Marine Thunderstorm Wind", "Marine Strong Wind", "Marine High Wind"),
                                  Lightning = c("Lightning", "Marine Lightning")))
  

g3 <- ggplot(stormidk, aes(x = YEAR, y = n, fill = lesstypes)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, begin = 0.2, end = 1, option = "A")

g3


```
